_meta.change: split the cogPG.PG113 whole-volume CGPG dump into per-work corpus files
_meta.plan_basis: fourth pass. Last pass left 284-313 uncarved because two different running heads ran over it and it was not established what they divided. They divide nothing: they alternate verso and recto over one work. Read off the page scans (Internet Archive item patrologia.graeca.org, file _113.zip). col = 2*locus - 22, pinned on our locus 248 being column 474.
_meta.shared_row_rule: a served row holding a work boundary is assigned to exactly one work, normally the one whose incipit the row carries; the plan records the decision as the ranges themselves
_meta.reversible: To revert: for every carved work file listed under 'works', drop its rows whose locus starts 'PG113.' (delete the file when it was 'created'), strip the 'PG113.' prefix from their loci, re-insert them and the archived 'dropped_duplicates' rows into data/corpus/cogPG.PG113.jsonl together with the residual rows, sorted by locus, and restore data/cgpg_works.json, data/tlg_crosswalk.json/.tsv, and data/corrections_log/provenance.json from the parent commit (or simply git revert the commit; old sha256 below verifies). Every moved row's text is byte-identical; only urn and locus changed.

works.title: Novellae constitutiones

incipit_checks.incipit: γενείας διῃρημένως ἢ ἀδιαιρέτως, ἢ ὡς ἐκ κοινῆς ἀγορασίας

works.evidence: 28 rows, 10,084 tokens. Columns 549-550 carry the full section title block, CONSTANTINI IMP. PORPHYROGENITI NOVELLAE CONSTITUTIONES, with its source line (Leunclavius, Jus Graeco-Romanum, Frankfurt 1596) and a MONITUM EDITORUM noting that these Novellae, like Leo the Wise's, largely concern ecclesiastical matters, and that the Delectus legum was printed earlier for the same reason. So Migne himself distinguishes the two works.\n\nThe previous pass left this block because NOVELLAE CONSTITUTIONES appeared at columns 553-554 and CONSTANTINI PORPHYROGENITI at 583-584 and 599-600, and whether that was one work or two was not established. It is one: pages 289, 290 and 291 are consecutive and read CONSTANTINI PORPHYROGENITI, NOVELLAE CONSTITUTIONES, CONSTANTINI PORPHYROGENITI, so the heads alternate verso and recto, author on one side and title on the other. No TLG anchor is claimed. Read off the page scans (Internet Archive item patrologia.graeca.org, file _113.zip). col = 2*locus - 22, pinned on our locus 248 being column 474.
works.notes: The first carved row, 286, has no incipit anchor because the work does not begin at the top of it: the row opens with the Delectus legum's last sentence and the Novellae title block follows partway down column 549. Under the shared-row rule the row goes to the work whose head it carries.

residual.note: 284-285 BELONGS TO THE DELECTUS LEGUM and is a known under-claim, 631 tokens, not an open question. It is that work's back matter: the ΤΩ ΑΝΑΓΝΩΣΤΗ ΧΑΙΡΕΙΝ / LECTORI SALUTEM note and the index of its tituli 29 to 59, all under the DELECTUS LEGUM running head at columns 545-546. Pass 3 stopped at 283 because locus 284's tail reads ΛΕΟΥΟΕΙ ΘΑΟΤΗΜ, which I took for a following work's head; the scans show it is LECTORI SALUTEM, the Delectus's own. Moving those two rows needs a separate reversible step, since a carve cannot re-open an applied one. 318-323 is prosopographical and excerpt matter (Dexippus, Malchus) and 328 opens ΠΕΡΙ ΠΡΕΣΒΕΩΝ ΡΩΜΑΙΩΝ, the Excerpta de legationibus; neither is researched here.

corrections_mirror_note: data/corrections_log/applied.jsonl keys this volume's corrections by bare column locus under cogPG.PG113; per the rekey_corrections_log.py convention for cogPG.* bare-locus rows they are left unchanged (historical). The locus map above makes the linkage reconstructable.
